# Neelkanth Gym website

- This is a Next.js App Router project using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React.
- The single-page landing page lives in `src/app/page.tsx`; global responsive design and motion styles live in `src/app/globals.css`.
- Preserve the dark/light theme toggle, responsive navigation, accessibility labels, reduced-motion support, SEO metadata, and LocalBusiness structured data.
- Gym photography uses temporary Unsplash URLs; owner and trainer portraits are explicitly marked placeholders until real images are supplied.
- Verify changes with `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.
